usedFor: Jobs and clients in ServiceM8, like “Job Completed”, tag or create contacts in LeadConnector.

bestTemplate.name: “Job Completed” in ServiceM8, then “Add/Remove Tags to Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: A completed job tags the customer's contact, which the action finds by email or phone.

watchOut: “New Form Response” in ServiceM8 needs the Forms add-on enabled in your account before it can fire.
